faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the TCIL Apprentice posts is 18 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Apprentice post in TCIL?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies for the Apprentice posts in Telecommunications Consultants India Limited (TCIL) as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Apprentice (Technician Diploma) post?
faq.answer: For the Apprentice (Technician Diploma) post, candidates must possess a 3-year Diploma in Electronics/Civil Engineering/Computer Science/IT from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to TCIL Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all Apprentice posts is between 18 years to 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for TCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the TCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Legal and Graduate Engineer Apprentices is Rs. 12,300/-, while for Technician Diploma Apprentices, it is Rs. 10,900/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for TCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on merit, followed by an interview and verification of certificates and testimonials.

faq.answer: Candidates need to apply through the offline mode by sending their filled application form along with required documents to the address specified in the notification.
